body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
GENIUS Act stablecoin rulemaking deadline landed July 18, forcing six federal agencies to finalize capital, reserve, and licensing rules for USDC/USAT issuers.
Stablecoin News
GENIUS Act rules finalized
Six federal agencies finalized capital, reserve, and licensing rules for stablecoin issuers; OCC set a $5M capital floor and FDIC confirmed no deposit insurance for token holders.
Treasury warns of $6.6T deposit flight risk
Treasury estimates yield-bearing stablecoins could pull up to $6.6 trillion from bank deposits, which legacy institutions call an existential threat to fractional-reserve banking.
Visa launches bank stablecoin platform
Visa unveiled a platform letting banks and fintechs issue, move, and manage stablecoins, broadening its crypto push as adoption widens.
EU MiCA transition period ends
The EU's MiCA transitional period closed July 1, requiring every crypto-asset service provider in the bloc to secure full authorization or shut down.
Hacking & Security Incidents
AFX Trade bridge exploit: $24M
An AFX-powered bridge on Arbitrum was drained of about $24.15M in USDC on July 22; the attacker converted proceeds to ETH and consolidated in one wallet.
Triple-A hot wallets drained: $9.7M
Payments firm Triple-A had hot wallets drained across TRON, Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum on July 25; the firm says customer funds were not affected.
Wanchain, Verus bridges hit same week
Bridge exploits at Wanchain and Verus, plus an Allbridge Core flash-loan drain and a B² Network staking contract seizure, pushed weekly hack losses past $47M.
Ostium oracle manipulation hack
Arbitrum-based perps exchange Ostium lost an estimated $18-24M after an attacker used a compromised price-oracle private key to push fake future-dated price reports.
